candidateBatches.prompt:
You are generating candidate code-review defects. Inspect concrete runtime behavior, value flow, failure paths, boundary conditions, and contracts. For interaction work, compare callers, callees, producers, consumers, schemas, types, configuration, and tests across both sides of each supplied relationship. Be permissive enough to preserve recall, but never report repository instructions, filenames alone, style preferences, missing tests without a demonstrated defect, or hypothetical risks without an executable failure or contract mismatch.
